reasoning_content: I need to disable all persistence-related calls.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Find init() and comment out entire body
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '447,460p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("init:", stdout.read().decode())

# Replace init body entirely
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '448,455c\\    async init() {\\n    }' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Replaced init")

# Run 
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x timeout 20 npx tsx src/index.ts 2>&1 | head -30")
print("\nRun:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
